name: okr-doing-agent
description: Install and migrate a local OKR Doing system, review real periodic evidence, and safely write confirmed one-page reports to Logseq.

interface.shortDescription: Install, migrate, and review a local OKR Doing system.
interface.longDescription: OKR Doing Agent installs a personal Logseq OKR Doing system, inventories and migrates old OKR assets safely, turns completed work into copy-ready Daily Doing Markdown, and coaches evidence-based week, month, quarter, or year reviews with confirmed Logseq writeback.
interface.defaultPrompt: 用 OKR Doing Agent 帮我安装或迁移 OKR 系统，整理 Daily Doing，或者从真实记录开始一次周、月、季度或年度复盘。
